buildConfigFiles.name: electron/package.json
buildConfigFiles.content:
{
  "name": "lights-out-electron",
  "version": "11.1.3",
  "description": "Lights Out - Sleep Timer (Electron Edition)",
  "main": "main.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "electron .",
    "build": "powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-native-windows.ps1",
    "dist": "powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-native-windows.ps1",
    "icons": "node scripts/make-icons.js",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "smoke": "node scripts/smoke.js",
    "smoke:companion": "node scripts/companion-smoke.js",
    "smoke:packaged": "node scripts/packaged-smoke.js && node scripts/packaged-truth-smoke.js",
    "smoke:native": "node scripts/native-packaged-truth-smoke.js",
    "smoke:reliability": "node scripts/reliability-crash-policy-proof.js",
    "smoke:performance": "node scripts/performance-resize-gate.js",
    "smoke:phone": "node scripts/packaged-phone-smoke.js",
    "test:uninstall-matrix": "powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/uninstall-matrix.ps1",
    "smoke:network": "node scripts/packaged-network-smoke.js",
    "test:geometry": "electron scripts/window-geometry-runtime.js",
    "test:night-modes-runtime": "node scripts/night-modes-electron-proof.js",
    "test:companion-v2-runtime": "node scripts/companion-v2-electron-proof.js",
    "test:receipt-recovery-runtime": "node scripts/receipt-recovery-electron-proof.js",
    "electron:provision": "install-electron --no",
    "electron:verify": "node scripts/verify-electron-provisioning.js",
    "electron:verify-provision": "npm run electron:verify",
    "check-node": "node scripts/check-node.js",
    "preflight": "npm run check-node && npm run electron:verify",
    "test": "node --test"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13.0"
  },
  "author": "Lights Out",
  "license": "MIT",
  "build": {
    "appId": "com.lightsout.sleep-timer",
    "productName": "Lights Out",
    "directories": {
      "output": "../dist"
    },
    "files": [
      "main.js",
      "preload.js",
      "index.html",
      "styles.css",
      "renderer-utils.js",
      "renderer-help.js",
      "renderer-nav.js",
      "renderer-profiles.js",
      "renderer-calendar.js",
      "renderer-receipts.js",
      "renderer-family-remote.js",
      "renderer-ritual-focus.js",
      "renderer-settings.js",
      "renderer-lastlight-alarm.js",
      "renderer-onboarding-updater.js",
      "renderer.js",
      "smartLights.js",
      "profiles.js",
      "profileIdentity.js",
      "windowGeometry.js",
      "calendar.js",
      "settings.js",
      "lastLight.js",
      "streaks.js",
      "alarm.js",
      "updater.js",
      "updaterPolicy.js",
      "calendarProviders.js",
      "companion.js",
      "companionNetwork.js",
      "companionFirewall.js",
      "capabilityTruth.js",
      "companion.html",
      "media.js",
      "unsavedGuard.js",
      "family.js",
      "remoteControl.js",
      "wifiGuard.js",
      "contentBlocker.js",
      "accountability.js",
      "focusSessions.js",
      "screenTime.js",
      "sleepDebt.js",
      "emergencyOverride.js",
      "runReceipts.js",
      "ambientVisuals.js",
      "idleDetection.js",
      "bedtimeReminder.js",
      "overrideTax.js",
      "autopilot.js",
      "ritualMode.js",
      "profileRitualContext.js",
      "statsDashboard.js",
      "smartSuggestions.js",
      "nightModes.js",
      "startDecision.js",
      "renderer-night-modes.js",
      "widget.html",
      "assets/**"
    ],
    "win": {
      "target": [
        {
          "target": "portable",
          "arch": [
            "x64"
          ]
        },
        {
          "target": "nsis",
          "arch": [
            "x64"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "icon": "assets/icon.ico"
    },
    "portable": {
      "artifactName": "LightsOut.exe"
    },
    "nsis": {
      "oneClick": false,
      "allowToChangeInstallationDirectory": true,
      "createDesktopShortcut": true,
      "createStartMenuShortcut": true,
      "shortcutName": "Lights Out"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "qrcode": "^1.5.4",
    "sharp": "^0.35.3"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "electron": "^43.0.0",
    "eslint": "10.7.0",
    "png-to-ico": "^3.0.1",
    "rcedit": "5.0.2",
    "ws": "^8.21.0"
  }
}
